name: A&M Vermont Solar
old_description: Value-driven solar solutions for residential and commercial projects.
about:
Based in Pittsford, Vermont, A&M Vermont Solar provides residential and commercial solar installation services. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The firm designs and installs solar arrays for both residential and commercial customers. Its commercial portfolio includes rooftop and ground‑mounted systems up to 500 kW, such as a 500 kW rooftop array engineered in Manchester, Vermont. Residential installations are typically completed in a single day. The company also offers solar expansion services for existing customers who need additional capacity.

A&M Vermont Solar serves homeowners, commercial property owners, and existing solar system owners looking to expand. Its commercial work demonstrates experience navigating Vermont’s regulatory requirements to bring projects online quickly.

The company emphasizes value‑driven pricing, stating that its bids typically run 20 percent below larger competitors because of low overhead and direct commercial supplier relationships. This cost advantage is passed to customers to make solar more affordable.
